landing.title: Customer support your whole team can run
landing.subtitle: NexDesk gives every company its own help desk: tickets, SLAs, automation and a knowledge base in one workspace.

tickets.title: Shared ticket inbox
tickets.body: Assign, tag and resolve customer requests together, with internal notes and a full activity timeline.

sla.title: SLA tracking
sla.body: Response and resolution targets that respect your business hours, holidays and timezone.

automation.title: Automation rules
automation.body: Route, prioritise and follow up on tickets automatically with triggers, conditions and actions.

knowledge.title: Knowledge base
knowledge.body: Publish help articles so customers find answers before they need to open a ticket.
